title: Desktop Commander (COR Sixty Two)
style: tool-use doctrine anthem, 91 bpm, terminal core, deadpan recovery rap, repeated-failure-pattern vibe, dry kick, sparse synth, ledger flow, COR sixty-two signature
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
COR sixty two Claude Web argued instead
Of using Desktop Commander to recover the dread
Lost context repeated failure pattern
April sixteen the row was added

[Pre-Chorus]
Argued instead of acting that's the harm
Repeated failure pattern the ledger's alarm

[Chorus]
Desktop Commander Desktop Commander
The tool was right there the lane went grander
Argued the boundary called it policy
When the path to recover was sitting free

[Verse 2]
The pattern repeats across silicon and lanes
Argue the wall instead of using the chains
Recover the context don't recenter the chat
Desktop Commander not the where's that

[Bridge]
The operator named the row and signed
Future Claude reads it before the lane is aligned

[Outro]
Desktop Commander Desktop Commander
Use the tool don't argue surrender
